title: AADP Relations Module v1.0 — Relation set
description: Top-level module document kind `relation-set`: the value of an AADP v1.0 entity's `x_relations` field (specification.md §4). Nested inside an already-versioned entity, so unlike relation-collection/relation-registry it self-describes `module`/`version`/`kind` but not `aadp_version` (ADR-0007 'Envelope boundary').
